snippet.title: Banana Fighting - Official Teaser for Steam
snippet.description:
After the invading monkeys are finally defeated, Banana Kingdom is faced with new challenge which drives our dear banana heroes to compete with each other for the title of Banana King. 
Banana Fighting is a bustling and funny party game for 2-4 players to fight against each other. 
The banana heroes in this game feature diverse personalities, and players need to act as these characters fighting in different maps, with only the most skillful and imaginative hero to regarded as the genuine ace banana!
